organization: Harborview Care United and the rest of the fictional demo network (src/data/fallback.js and src/data/demoSeed.js)
notice: Every person here is invented. Each persona plays one seat of the auth-free demo: the Worker seat is Darnell Foster's, and the staff seats are the demo hats (hat keys are the STAFF_PLANES keys). Names already in src/data/fallback.js keep the roles they have there. Adapted from an earlier Tamarack Valley persona format.

personas.bio: Votes on every campaign ballot, checks his open issue on lunch breaks and reads his organizing rights before meetings.
personas.voice: Plain and brief. Wants to know what happens next.

personas.bio: Reads the app on his phone after shift and prefers Spanish. His phone is set to Spanish, so the demo opens in Spanish; he reads his organizing rights there.
On the organizing committee since 2021. Works worker requests first thing and sends a broadcast most weeks.
personas.voice: Warm, specific, always names the deadline.

personas.bio: Runs the issue queue and watches the soonest deadline.
personas.voice: Terse. Issue references, steps and dates.

personas.bio: Reads campaign health and the collective workplace log before each leadership meeting.
personas.voice: Measured. Asks what the numbers do not show.

personas.bio: Keeps roles, two-step sign-in and meeting check-in codes in order.
personas.voice: Procedural. Records why every role changed.

personas.bio: Reads the exec attention list before every leadership meeting.
personas.voice: Direct, short paragraphs, says what happens next.
